ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity pixels (white) and 55% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region occupies the distal two-thirds of the left lobe; low-intensity dark pigmentation dominates the proximal regions and the entirety of the right lobe, punctuated by small, discrete high-intensity circular nodes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a deep vertical bounding-box depth relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge boundary, appearing as a sequence of sharp pixel peaks and rounded valleys isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the trailing margins of both lobes, tapering towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast white circular and semi-circular ring-shaped pixel clusters distributed across the dark pigmented regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, dark linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible within the white pigmented area of the distal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-relief clusters of brownish-tan textured pixel masses (barnacle colonies) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
